title: Christ Has Brought Us Near
story:
Two children lived in houses on opposite sides of a small river.

They could see each other every day, but they could not easily visit because there was no bridge nearby.

One day, workers built a strong bridge across the river. For the first time, the children could walk across and meet each other freely.

The bridge did not simply make the journey easier. It removed the separation that had kept them apart.

Sometimes people can feel far away from God.

Sin can create a distance that we cannot remove by our own efforts. We may try to become better, do more good things, or make promises to change, but none of these things can remove sin by themselves.

Ephesians 2:13 gives us a beautiful reminder that those who were once far away have been brought near through the blood of Christ.

Jesus is the One who removes the separation between us and God.

His sacrifice on the cross makes it possible for us to come near to God with forgiveness, peace, and hope.

This means we do not have to live as people who are permanently separated from God.

Even when we have failed, we can turn back to Him.

Even when we feel unworthy, we can remember what Christ has done for us.

God does not ask us to build our own bridge to Him.

Christ has already made the way.

This truth should also change how we treat other people.

If Christ has brought us near to God through grace, we should not build walls of pride, hatred, unforgiveness, or prejudice between ourselves and others.

We can choose forgiveness, kindness, humility, and reconciliation.

Perhaps today you feel distant from God because of something in your past.

Do not remain far away.

Come to Christ.

His grace is greater than your failure, and His sacrifice has opened the way for you to draw near.

The One who was willing to shed His blood for you is also willing to receive you.

You are not without hope.

Through Christ, the distance has been removed, and you can come near to God.
life_lesson: Sin separates us from God, but Christ has opened the way for us to come near through His sacrifice. When you feel distant or unworthy, remember what Jesus has done and draw near to Him with faith.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for bringing me near through Jesus Christ.

Thank You that I do not have to remain separated from You because of my sins and failures.

Help me understand the depth of Christ's sacrifice and the grace You have given me.

When I feel distant from You or unworthy to come before You, remind me that Jesus has already opened the way.

Give me a heart that turns toward You instead of running away when I fail.

Help me receive Your forgiveness and live in the peace and hope You provide.

Remove pride, bitterness, unforgiveness, and anything else that creates distance between me and others.

Help me become a person who builds bridges instead of walls.

Teach me to forgive, show kindness, and seek reconciliation wherever possible.

Thank You for the cross and for the precious blood of Jesus that has brought me near.

Help me remain close to You and never forget the price that was paid for my salvation.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are there times when you feel too unworthy or guilty to come near to God?

What does Christ's sacrifice mean to you personally?

Is there someone with whom you need to remove a wall of anger, pride, or unforgiveness?
verse: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far away have been brought near by the blood of Christ.
